stories.title: Jamia's Department of Arabic holds literary and cultural programme with Arabic play and wall magazine launch
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia's Subject Association of the Department of Arabic organised literary and cultural performances, according to a university press release dated Thursday 8 October. The release says the programme was held at the Auditorium of the Faculty of Engineering, presided over by Prof. Fauzan Ahmad, head of the department, with Dr. Irshad Ahmad, a former Indian ambassador to Syria and Director of the Indian Council of World Affairs, as guest of honour. It lists Quran recitation, a naat, the Jamia Tarana, ghazal recitations, introductions by newly admitted students and an Arabic play, and says the students' quarterly wall magazine was launched. The release does not give the date of the event.
stories.check: The release page shows no date and only the headline; the 8 Oct date and the event details come from the English PDF (file name carries 2026October8). The event date is not stated. Confirm with Jamia.
